working_definition: Largest male reproductive tract cluster named for the ejaculatory bulb (authors' term FBbt:00004962, a structure); the cells are presumably the secretory columnar epithelial cells of the bulb wall.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell of the epithelium of the ejaculatory bulb. It secretes the male pheromone cis-vaccenyl acetate (cVA) (Guiraudie-Capraz et al., 2007).

justification: The authors' term is the organ (a structure). The bulb wall is a columnar epithelium, so the cell-level term is the ejaculatory bulb epithelial cell. Marked broad/medium because the organ label could include non-epithelial cells and the same term is also used for the separate 'ejaculatory bulb epithelium' cluster.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Bilaterally symmetric structure with two anterior and two posterior lateral lobes... walls consist of a thick columnar epithelium.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Authors' structure term; not a cell type.

other_candidates.fbbt_term: semen-secreting cell of the male reproductive system
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any cell of the male reproductive system that contributes to the production and secretion of seminal fluid proteins; includes accessory gland, seminal vesicle and ejaculatory bulb cells.

recommendation: Map to ejaculatory bulb epithelial cell as the cell-level equivalent; curator may wish to note overlap with the 'ejaculatory bulb epithelium' type.
